prompt_sha256_input: The expanded prompt string encoded as UTF-8, before passing it as the final positional argument to pi

case_input_serialization.note: Default separators and default escaping are retained exactly as used by the runner.

expansion.package: case package directory name, for example ddd-tactical
expansion.skill_system_prompt: The complete package SKILL.md is supplied separately through pi --system-prompt; it is not interpolated into this wrapper.

expansion_algorithm: Load case from package evals/evals.json without changing its object values.
Serialize case.input with json.dumps(case['input'], ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True).
Substitute package, case.id, case.prompt, and the serialized input into wrapper_template without further whitespace normalization.
Hash the resulting UTF-8 prompt string with SHA-256.
Pass that exact string as the final positional argument after -- to the command recipe recorded in the capture manifest.
